name: assets
description: Agentic access to the sollertia-shared-assets library. Authors, validates, and manages the configuration and metadata backbone of the Sollertia ecosystem, owns the session-discovery, session-filtering, and forged-dataset workflows consumed by every downstream batch plugin, and owns the library's extension path, the registry system by which a new acquisition system, session type, trial class, trigger type, read asset, or credentials category is added. Backed by the sollertia-shared-assets MCP server (slsa).
